name: Webform Submissions Delete
description: Bulk delete of Webform submissions by date range.
project_description:
This module is used to delete Webform submissions in bulk using a specified date range.

 This module will create a tab/link under the Webform Results tab, which will allow a user to delete submissions in bulk.

 Requirements 
 This module requires the Webform module:

 https://www.drupal.org/project/webform 

 Installation/Usage 
 
 Install module like any other contrib module. 
 Select any Webform with submissions. 
 Click on the "Results" tab. 
 Locate the "Bulk Delete" sub tab. 
 Select date range for bulk deletion of submissions. 
 Confirm submissions have been deleted.
